correctness.rationale: Deleting the fixed vertex gives a uniform rooted forest on N=n-1 labels with d rooted components and singleton components corresponding to leaf neighbors. Labeled rooted-tree EGF T=ze^T, Lagrange inversion [z^m]exp(jT)=j(m+j)^(m-1)/m!, and the diagonal action of D_N=N+(1-t)∂_t on (t-1)^k yield exactly the stated normalized PGF. The root-preservation lemma is not merely tested: coefficient [(N-k)a_k+(k+1)a_(k+1)] is nonnegative for degree< N, while logarithmic quotient N+(1-t)sum b_j/(t+lambda_j) is strictly decreasing between poles, giving all nonpositive real roots incl multiplicity. Grace-Walsh-Szegő polarization converts the univariate stable PGF to the real-stable symmetric multiaffine joint PGF; Borcea-Brändén-Liggett Thm4.9 yields negative association. The exact two-leaf probability ratio is <1 for 2<=d<=n-2 (including d=2 zero case); forest component sizes realize every claimed support value. Prüfer enumeration independently confirmed all PGFs for n=3..7 and checks sampled roots, not an all-n proof.
residual_risks: The strong Rayleigh transfer uses the published polarization theorem and negative-association result; those are explicitly cited, not independently reproved.
Numerical roots and finite Prüfer enumerations alone cannot establish all n; the displayed monotonic zero-preservation lemma supplies that step.
